cases.title: CDSYNC warns in one line first, relinks 12 pits and 50 pipes, and one U takes it back
cases.plan_item: UX-REP-01 CDSYNC (daily case D27, CDSYNC half); CDSYNC keeps the schedule (regression C42, reduced)
cases.expected: Typing CDSYNC prints '[CE] CDSYNC will re-link every pit and pipe in this drawing' and later 'CDSYNC complete. Pits relinked: 12, Pipes relinked: 50' (in that order); the number of objects in the drawing does not change; the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDSYNC completed'; one U echoes CDSYNC.
cases.why_not_unit: The order of the warning against the real write is only visible on the live command line, and the relink counts come from the real drawing.
not_automated: THE PIT SCHEDULE FIGURES ARE NOT COMPARED (card C42 assertion 2): the Pit Schedule window cannot be read or closed by the driver on build 3.0.72 (v2 ui close / ui press time out). This case does NOT prove that CDSYNC leaves the schedule alone.
CDREBUILD (D27 second half) has never been driven; its prompts are unknown.
